comment: Washout - a tempo-synced stereo feedback delay with a chain of 4 slowly modulated all-pass diffusers inside the loop, so the repeats melt into a reverb-like cloud (the Octatrack-style washout for transitions). Time is free 12 ms..1 s or a note value 1/32..2bar at the pedal's tempo; Wash = diffusion, Fdbk 0-120 (100 = 1:1, soft-clipped above), HiCut and LoCut in the loop (0 = off), Mod = diffuser modulation, Width, Send (how much input feeds the wash, smoothed; 0 = only the tail rings): the one live control, the dry always passes at full level. The footswitch is plain on/off with trails: off stops new input and the tail rings out, the dry is untouched. Fdbk 100 + Send 0 + both cuts off holds the cloud.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 480 DualShft, 481 LOUDER, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate, 489 S.GN_L, 490 Scrub, 491 DirtBox, 492 Washout, 493 Breather, 495 GRDELAY, 496 Sweep, 497 Looper (this pack; 492 was used by the dropped Metro branch, 498-500 by the probes). Not checked against the stock ZDLs on this PC (none present): run build/extract_effect_db.py with stock_zdls/ to confirm.
audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.

params.name: Time
params.comment: 0..100 free: ms = 12 + 0.0988 x screen^2 (12 ms..1.00 s), as GRDELAY. 101..113 = note values at the pedal's tempo: 1/32, 1/16T, 1/16, 1/8T, 1/16., 1/8, 1/4T, 1/8., 1/4, 1/4., 1/2, 1bar, 2bar. Too long for the 3.8 s ring = halved until it fits. Default 109 = 1/4.

params.name: Wash
params.comment: Diffusion: the all-pass coefficient of the 4 diffusers in the loop, 0..0.7. 0 = diffusers skipped. Default 70.

params.name: Fdbk
params.comment: Feedback: gain into the loop = screen / 100, 100 = 1:1 (holds forever with Send 0 and both cuts off), above 100 it grows into a cloud the soft clip holds. Switched off it is capped at 95 so the tail fades. Default 60.

params.name: HiCut
params.comment: Low-pass in the loop: 0 = off (skipped), 1 = 11.6 kHz, 100 = 375 Hz. Default 0.

params.name: LoCut
params.comment: High-pass in the loop: 0 = off (skipped), 1 = 25 Hz, 100 = 800 Hz. Default 0.

params.name: Mod
params.comment: Depth of the slow modulation of the diffuser lengths (up to 20 samples at 100, 0.3-0.7 Hz). Default 20.

params.name: Width
params.comment: Stereo width of the wet signal: 0 = mono, 100 = as is. Default 100.

params.name: Send
params.comment: How much input feeds the wash, smoothed over about 7 ms. 0 = only the tail keeps ringing. Default 100.

dsp_cost_comment: Estimate (the spec says 25-30): per side per sample a 2-tap interpolated ring read (crossfaded), 4 interpolated all-pass stages, 2 optional one-poles, a soft clip and a ring write. Idle (off or Send 0 and the tail died) costs about nothing. Re-measure on the pedal.
